1797, mmanụ na kwaaji. Site na Thomas Lawrence (1769-1833). Site n'ikike nke Charles Darwin Foundation. Site na mkpokọta nzuzo nke Oriakụ Margaret Darwin, nwa nwa Charles Darwin. E gosipụtara nke mbụ na Darwin Museum, Oxford; echekwara ugbu a na St. Andrews University Library.
Ọkachamara kachasị n'ụwa, Daniel George Brauey (1773-1848), rụrụ ọrụ dị ka onye na-ahụ maka anụ ụlọ na London Zoo. Ọ nwụrụ na njem ụgbọ mmiri nke mere ka Charles Darwin laghachi England, na-ahapụ Darwin na nwanne nna ya John nchịkọta anụ ahụ dum, gụnyere ọtụtụ ụdị nke ijiji na butterflies. Mpempe akwụkwọ ndetu Brauey nwere ugbu a na Darwin's Museum, Oxford.
N'ezie, Brauey zutere Darwin na mbụ na 1817 na Zoological Society of London. A họpụtara Charles Darwin ka ọ bụrụ onye otu Society, ya na Captain Robert Falcon Scott, na February 1831 - afọ atọ tupu njem njem ya a ma ama nke May ruo December.
